page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8te.4xlarge is an accelerated compute instance within the Compute Optimized with GPU family, engineered on KVM virtualization. Processing is driven by a 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 6462C processor offering 16 dedicated vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture. System memory totals 128.0 GB, establishing a resource ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Ada Lovelace generation GPU equipped with 48 GB of dedicated video memory.

Storage and connectivity characteristics reflect network-dependent design choices. The server includes no local instance storage, requiring persistent data and operational file systems to rely entirely on attached cloud block storage services. Networking capabilities are configured with a baseline throughput of 16 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance by default.

The combination of dedicated CPU cores, substantial system memory, and a 48 GB Ada Lovelace accelerator delivers strong efficiency for single-accelerator tasks without the financial and operational overhead of multi-GPU topologies. With substantial GPU memory available, the system is suitable for AI inference, deep learning model serving, video transcoding, 3D graphics rendering, and scientific computing tasks.

The pairing of dedicated high-frequency compute cores, dense memory capacity, and large GPU memory enables effective execution of GPU-dependent workloads such as deep learning inference, high-resolution rendering, computer vision, and accelerated data processing pipelines.
